sentences.text: The petitioner has approached this court seeking an expeditious consideration of Ext.P10, which is an application filed by the petitioner before the Arbitrator under Section 3G (5) of the National Highways Act, 1956.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and considering similar orders issued by this court, this writ petition will stand disposed of directing the 2nd respondent to consider and pass orders Ext.P10 in accordance with law and after affording an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and all affected parties within a period of one year from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
